newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold volume surges as prices ease.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold volume surges as prices ease.

text.p: Volume on the Istanbul gold exchange surged to 1,470 kg on Thursday from 552 kg on Wednesday, with banks engaging in arbitrage deals as gold prices fell abroad and the lira eased against the dollar, dealers said.
Gold closed lower at $350.00 an ounce after Wednesday's $351.50 and at 1,304,100 lira per gram versus 1,309,700.
The Turkish currency closed slightly weaker at 115,870 lira to the dollar from the previous 115,800.
Of the day's 1,470 kg of trade, 630 kg was conducted in the morning and 840 kg in the afternoon. 52.4 percent of the total was traded in lira terms.
